scripts.start: npm run docker:prod:up && npm run db:prod:init && tsx src/core/index.ts
scripts.facade:rebuild: docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test up --build -d facade-test --wait && echo 'Facade rebuilt, checkpoints preserved. Use :clean if state schema changed.'
scripts.facade:rebuild:clean: docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test up --build -d facade-test --wait && docker exec waymates-postgres-test psql -U postgres -d waymates_facade_test -c 'TRUNCATE facade.checkpoints, facade.checkpoint_writes, facade.checkpoint_blobs CASCADE;' && echo 'Facade rebuilt, checkpoints CLEARED.'
scripts.lint: eslint src/core src/facade src/shared src/telegram-bot src/chart database tests
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src/core src/facade src/shared src/telegram-bot src/chart database tests --fix
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:setup && npm run test:integration:run && npm run test:functional:run && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:dev && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:integration:dev: npm run test:setup && npm run test:integration:run
scripts.test:integration:gds: npm run test:setup && vitest --run --project gds-projection-tests --project gds-similarity-tests && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:integration:reason: npm run test:setup && vitest --run --project reason-tests && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:functional: npm run test:setup && npm run test:functional:run && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:setup: docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test up neo4j-test -d --wait && npm run db:test:init
scripts.test:setup:kaggle: npm run test:setup && npx tsx scripts/import-kaggle.ts
scripts.test:facade:setup: docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test up --build -d --wait && npm run db:test:init
scripts.test:facade:run: docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test up --build -d --wait && vitest --run --project facade-integration
scripts.test:facade: npm run test:facade:setup && npm run test:facade:run && npm run test:facade:teardown
scripts.test:telegram:setup: docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test up --build -d --wait && npm run db:test:init
scripts.test:telegram: npm run test:telegram:setup && npm run test:telegram:run && npm run test:facade:teardown
scripts.docker:prod:down: docker compose --env-file .env.prod --profile prod stop && docker compose --env-file .env.prod --profile prod rm -f
scripts.docker:test:down: docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test stop neo4j-test && docker compose --env-file .env.test --profile test rm -f neo4j-test
scripts.db:prod:init: scripts/db.sh prod -f /tmp/init.cypher && scripts/import-skills.sh prod && scripts/import-positions.sh prod && scripts/import-domains.sh prod && scripts/import-roles.sh prod && scripts/import-reasons.sh prod && scripts/import-languages.sh prod && scripts/import-industries.sh prod && scripts/import-education-levels.sh prod
scripts.db:prod:clean: scripts/db.sh prod -d neo4j "MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n"
scripts.db:prod:status: scripts/db.sh prod -d neo4j "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) as total_nodes"
scripts.db:test:init: scripts/db.sh test -f /tmp/init.cypher && scripts/import-skills.sh test && scripts/import-positions.sh test && scripts/import-domains.sh test && scripts/import-roles.sh test && scripts/import-reasons.sh test && scripts/import-languages.sh test && scripts/import-industries.sh test && scripts/import-education-levels.sh test
scripts.db:test:clean: scripts/db.sh test -d neo4j "MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n"
scripts.db:test:status: scripts/db.sh test -d neo4j "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) as total_nodes"
scripts.structurizr:down: docker compose stop structurizr && docker compose rm -f structurizr
scripts.structurizr:restart: npm run structurizr:down && npm run structurizr:up
scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run check:lint && npm run check:tests
scripts.e2e:batch: bash -c 'set -a && source .env.test && set +a && npx tsx poc/mcp-chat.ts --batch'
